2) Criminal lawyer in Los Angeles, CA.

3) Cardiologist in Chicago, IL.

4) Orthopedic doctor in Houston, TX.

Then second: lawyer_search({"location":"Los Angeles, CA","expertise":"Criminal"}).

Third: doctor_search({"location":"Chicago, IL","specialization":"Cardiology"}).
